implementation_strategy: Dockerized CI images host deterministic verifiers (syntax_parser_v1, reachability_checker_v1, acl_policy_checker_v1) and Mininet emulation. For each predeclared task_index: (1) produce a single shared initial generation call (shared_initial_candidate) via openai_responses:gpt-5-mini; (2) record baseline outcome from the initial candidate; (3) run guarded pipeline that consumes verifier traces and, if deterministic validation fails, invoke at most one automated repair call; all artifacts (raw LLM outputs, verifier traces, emulation logs) are archived. Execution uses only hosted model API calls and CPU containerized emulation; no human labour or external private resources are used.
public_resources: Benchmark specification: Mininet-based Multi‑Vendor Template Stress Set (provenance-traced) — assets packaged in the study's Docker CI artifact (archived with hashes)
model_and_version_plan: All model calls: openai_responses / gpt-5-mini (model_name/model_version = gpt-5-mini).
Sampling policy: temperature=0.0 where supported; record provider runtime sampling parameters and seed=0 where supported.
task_manifest_strategy: Use the adapter's deterministic challenging_workflow_stress_v1 profile to select 200 task_indices before any model calls. No randomisation of selection; selection is outcome-independent and fixed.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Two transformation pipelines per pre-registered design: baseline=direct_configuration_generation_v1 (initial candidate only, shared_initial_candidate semantics); guarded=generate_validate_repair_v1 (initial candidate + at most one automated repair iteration using deterministic verifier feedback and the automatic_rejection_rules in transformation_validation).
randomisation_plan: None. Task selection and ordering follow the adapter's deterministic challenging_workflow_stress_v1 profile (selection is outcome-independent). Within each execution batch tasks execute in the declared index order for traceable provenance.
caching_plan: Cache and de-duplicate raw LLM responses, verifier traces, and emulation outputs by deterministic artifact hashes. If an identical prompt+context hash is observed, flag as duplicate per contamination_plan and exclude from primary confirmatory analysis. Cached artifacts are used only for reproducibility and to avoid redundant provider calls when identical requests occur; caching does not change scientific pair procedures or the predeclared model-call accounting.
failure_recovery_plan: Infrastructure failures: automated container restart and batch requeue permitted subject to wall-clock and model-call budget limits; all technical restarts logged with hash and timestamp. Provider/API transient errors: up to adapter-permitted infrastructure recovery actions (no additional model-call attempts beyond the adapter's maximum_attempts_per_call=1 for the same scientific call). Pairs aborted due to mapping_validation or CI template substitution failures are excluded from primary paired test and logged; sensitivity analyses include them per preregistration. No human adjudication or manual repairs are performed.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (version 1.0) — per-episode record fields: study_id, task_index, condition (baseline|guarded), prompt_bundle_hash, raw_model_calls (list of {call_id, model_name, model_version, datetime, sampling_params, input_prompt, raw_output}), verifier_traces (syntax_parser, reachability_checker, acl_policy_checker outputs with deterministic verdicts), mininet_emulation_result (reachability matrix, packet traces), policy_violation_flag (boolean; deterministic scoring), automated_repair_applied (boolean), model_calls_count (integer), execution_batch_id, artifact_hashes. Consumer analysis code expects this schema exactly.
estimated_compute_notes: Planned worst-case model calls = 400 (2 per task: one shared initial + one repair). Hosted-model API usage only (openai_responses:gpt-5-mini). Dockerized CPU Mininet emulation and deterministic verifiers run across 5 batches; estimated wall-clock < 7 days on typical CI host. Token budget per call upper bound set to 2000 tokens; record actual tokens per call. All artifacts archived with hashes to permit external verification within public-resources constraints.
